results.title: Ambuja Cements share price target: Nuvama, Motilal, other brokerages see up to 30% upside. Here's why
results.description: Ambuja Cements shares rose over 1% despite reporting a 34% YoY decline in Q1 FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 577 crore. Revenue fell 7.5%, while EBITDA dropped 19% and margins narrowed due to higher fuel and raw material costs amid the West Asia crisis. Despite the weak quarter, brokerages retained their 'Buy' ratings, citing strong long-term growth prospects.

results.title: Mah Sing's Kulai industrial park to diversify sales mix: CIMB Securities
results.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Mah Sing Group Bhd's planned industrial park in Kulai, Johor, is expected to diversify the property developer's sales mix and strengthen its exposure to the fast-growing industrial segment, CIMB Securities Sdn Bhd said.
